## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the literal text of a [`gmeow:NamePart`](../classes/gmeow-NamePart.md) — the actual string of a given name, surname, particle, or initial.

### Avoid when

- Avoid carrying the whole name here (that is [`gmeow:fullName`](gmeow-fullName.md) on the appellation) and avoid an untagged literal where a language or script is known — tag it for correct matching and rendering.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:partText`](gmeow-partText.md) on a [`gmeow:NamePart`](../classes/gmeow-NamePart.md), language-/script-tagging the literal; add [`gmeow:partExpansion`](gmeow-partExpansion.md) when the text is an abbreviated initial.

### Examples

- ex:audleySurname [`gmeow:partText`](gmeow-partText.md) "Audley"@en.
